single_reference_warning: No item is a VALIDATED_STYLE_SIGNATURE. Every item requires controlled output validation.

hypotheses.statement: The primary display name behaves as one authored graphic object with legible character identity, not as a conventional stock-font line.
hypotheses.causal_reason: This object supplies the first read and enough mass to coexist with the active photograph.
hypotheses.falsifier: New copy becomes a stock line, copied source outline, three disconnected blocks or unreadable texture.

hypotheses.statement: The page maintains distinct dominant, supporting and tertiary/ownership readings through scale, contrast and spatial separation.
hypotheses.causal_reason: Multiple information types remain usable without flattening into one promotional block.
hypotheses.falsifier: Support copy competes with the title or tertiary elements disappear into noise.
hypotheses.transfer_test_needed: COMPOSITION_VARIATION and ASPECT_ADAPT at thumbnail/normal view.

hypotheses.statement: Type scale/weight/contrast are locally calibrated to image luminance and frequency; small copy uses quiet pockets while dominant type may cross richer texture.
hypotheses.causal_reason: This makes photograph and information one system without blank panels.
hypotheses.falsifier: One global overlay treatment, low local legibility or universal dark boxes.

hypotheses.statement: The photographic field retains meaningful near/mid/far staging or an equivalent spatial-depth mechanism around the information plane.
hypotheses.causal_reason: Depth supplies environmental authorship and avoids a flat stock-background effect.
hypotheses.falsifier: Uniform sharpness, generic flat nature image or artificial blur unrelated to scene geometry.
hypotheses.transfer_test_needed: CONTENT_SWAP with a different truthful environment.

hypotheses.statement: Display-title mass and photographic texture density are mutually calibrated; both cannot be weak or maximized everywhere.
hypotheses.causal_reason: The title stays authoritative while the environment remains an active identity-bearing field.
hypotheses.falsifier: Title is swallowed, photograph is erased, or both layers compete everywhere.

hypotheses.statement: Graphic intervention preserves continuous photographic texture, natural edges and selective depth instead of converting the image into synthetic poster texture.
hypotheses.causal_reason: The source's environmental credibility depends on visible natural detail and restrained compositing.
hypotheses.falsifier: Global distress, plastic microtexture, over-sharpening, excessive glow or collage seams dominate the photograph.
hypotheses.transfer_test_needed: Detail-scale review after every future operator test.
